name: Pi Coding Agent: The SDK Is the Real Reason to Care | Thomas Wiegold Blog
description: I spent a week with the Pi coding agent. The CLI is good, not revolutionary — the TypeScript SDK is what makes it worth switching. Setup, extensions, and a working build.
